what_they_do: Advance is a banking and payments platform built for insurance agencies, MGAs, and wholesale brokers that hold client premium money in trust accounts. It automates matching carrier statements to invoices, splitting commissions between agencies and producers, and reconciling trust account balances, work that agencies currently do by hand across separate bank accounts, policy admin systems, and spreadsheets. It also lets agencies earn yield on the premium balances they are required to hold, turning idle compliance-mandated cash into revenue.
vertical: insurance fintech / MGA and agency banking infrastructure
theme_fit_rationale: Advance reconciles premium money movement across banking, policy admin, and general ledger systems that don't talk to each other today, and the resulting trust account ledger becomes a system of record for insurance intermediaries over time. Secondarily, its Addie AI matches unstructured carrier statements against invoices, which is a document-processing wedge into that reconciliation workflow.
